name: Seed Mold / Fungal Infection
visual_symptoms: white fuzzy coating on seed surface
gray or black powdery patches
dark fuzzy spots on shell
discolored slimy areas on seed coat
causes: Excess moisture during storage, poor airflow, contaminated growing medium
treatment: Discard all affected seeds. Store remaining seeds in cool dry airtight container with silica gel. Never germinate visibly moldy seeds.
germination_impact: Will not germinate. Mold destroys embryo and spreads to healthy seeds.

name: Immature / Underdeveloped Seed
visual_symptoms: pale green or white coloring
flat or concave shape lacking fullness
soft or papery shell that bends easily
small size compared to mature seeds of same strain
no visible markings or tiger stripes
causes: Harvested too early, insufficient pollination, poor nutrient availability during seed development
treatment: Do not attempt to germinate — viability is very low. Discard and source properly matured seeds.
germination_impact: Very low germination rate. Embryo not fully developed.

name: Cracked or Damaged Shell
visual_symptoms: visible cracks or splits along seed shell
chipped or broken seed coat edges
crushed or deformed shape
exposed interior through shell gaps
causes: Physical damage during handling, transport, or improper storage. Pest damage.
treatment: Seeds with minor cracks may still germinate. Seeds with major cracks or exposed interior should be discarded.
germination_impact: Reduced germination rate. Cracked seeds are vulnerable to pathogens during germination.

name: Pest Damage
visual_symptoms: small holes or bore marks on seed shell
tunnels or channels through seed coat
irregular surface pitting or scarring
frass or debris attached to seed surface
causes: Seed weevils, moth larvae, or other storage pests burrowing into seeds
treatment: Discard all damaged seeds. Inspect remaining seeds carefully. Store in sealed airtight containers. Use food-grade diatomaceous earth around storage area.
germination_impact: Will not germinate. Interior embryo has been consumed or destroyed.

name: Rot / Internal Decay
visual_symptoms: dark brown or black discoloration spreading across shell
soft squishy texture when pressed
sunken or collapsed areas on seed surface
foul smell if present
seed feels hollow or unusually light
causes: Prolonged moisture exposure, bacterial or fungal rot during storage, harvest in wet conditions
treatment: Discard immediately. Do not store near healthy seeds. Inspect entire seed batch.
germination_impact: Zero germination potential. Embryo destroyed by decay.

name: Old / Degraded Seed
visual_symptoms: extremely pale or bleached shell color
dull matte finish with no sheen
very dry and brittle appearance
loss of original markings and patterns
shriveled or wrinkled surface
causes: Improper long-term storage, exposure to heat or light, age beyond viable storage period (2-5 years)
treatment: Soak in water for 24 hours before germination attempt. Use hydrogen peroxide solution soak to stimulate. Success rate will be low.
germination_impact: Low germination rate. Viability decreases significantly after 2+ years without proper cold storage.

name: Chemical Contamination
visual_symptoms: unusual discoloration in uneven patches
oily or waxy residue on seed surface
staining patterns inconsistent with natural markings
abnormal sheen or coating
causes: Pesticide exposure, chemical treatment during storage, contaminated growing medium
treatment: Rinse thoroughly with clean water. If contamination suspected, soak in clean water 24h before germinating. Avoid seeds from unknown sources.
germination_impact: May germinate but resulting plant can carry chemical residues.

name: Abnormal Shape / Deformation
visual_symptoms: very elongated or flat shape instead of teardrop/oval
twisted or irregular seed form
asymmetrical shape significantly different from normal
double or fused seeds
causes: Genetic abnormality, stress during seed development, physical deformation
treatment: Can attempt germination — shape does not always indicate non-viability. Deformed seeds often still germinate.
germination_impact: Unpredictable. Some deformed seeds germinate normally; others do not.
